text: hey i want you to make me a zig-based obj/glb loader that doesnt have to handle a fk load of data back and forth from react. just load up the model one time and crisp butter smooth viewing is the mvp. drop in a model to view would be hot. lets do it
resolution: Built a native GLB/OBJ model viewer: drop a file and view it crisp + butter-smooth, with zero geometry crossing the JS bridge (the explicit contrast with the Studio's importMesh.ts EditMesh round-trip). New framework/world/mesh_import.zig parses GLB v2 (node TRS, merged meshes) + Wavefront OBJ into non-indexed interleaved verts + bbox (headless unit tests, verified on real car.obj/Desk.glb/tree.obj). gpu/3d.zig gained a host mesh stash + lazy intern-on-first-draw (geometry resolves by intern key alone, no React verts) and a native orbit camera so moving the view never re-renders the cart. Doors __mesh_load_file/__model_orbit_drag/__model_orbit_zoom parse+upload once and feed the host orbit state via markDirty. Scene3D.Camera orbit + Scene3D.Mesh hostKey props; cart/modelview.tsx (drop, or RJIT_MODEL=path to open from CLI). Self-shot verified all three formats render and auto-frame.
